extDescription.message: See any page's design values, and match them against your MUI theme — on production sites, not just localhost.

popupToggleInspect.message: Toggle inspect mode on this tab

hintEnableSite.message: For deployed/production sites, not just localhost. Grants access and starts inspecting this page immediately.

ctxOpenInEditor.message: Open this element’s source in my editor

hintAllSites.message: Convenience option for when you inspect many different sites. Chrome will warn that the extension can read all sites — that is inherent to inspecting arbitrary pages. If you would rather not, use "Enable on current site" each time instead; nothing is lost. Revoke anytime with the same button. Already-open tabs need one reload.

permError.message: The permission request didn't go through — close this popup, open it again, and press the button once more.

siteUnavailable.message: This page (non-http/https or unknown URL) can't be enabled.

siteUnknownUrl.message: This tab does not report a URL (a blob: preview, for example). With all-sites access granted, the inspector can still be injected — press the button to try.

injectError.message: Couldn't start on this page. Reload it and try again.

hintConfigureShortcuts.message: Opens chrome://extensions/shortcuts, where you can assign or change the key for inspect mode. Chrome leaves a shortcut unassigned when another extension already uses the same keys.

inspectOn.message: Inspect ON — hover to inspect, Esc to exit. ⌘/Ctrl+Click: open in editor / Alt+Click: what rendered this / ↑↓: parent/child

inspectOnSafe.message: Inspect ON — React production build: no component names or source jump, but design values and token matching work. Esc to exit

inspectOnNoReact.message: Inspect ON — no React on this page. Design values, CSS variable names and grid checks work. Esc to exit

jumpUnresolved.message: Could not resolve source location (React 19 may need the Babel source plugin)

jumpProd.message: Source jump is unavailable on production builds

sourceMinified.message: bundled output · run a dev build to jump

editorNotOpened.message: Nothing opened — your editor may not be installed, or its URL scheme is not registered.

chainEmpty.message: Nothing to show — this element has no React owner (plain DOM, or a production build with names stripped).

noSourceDom.message: This element is not a React component, so it has no source file to open.

renderOn.message: Render viz ON — re-rendered elements flash (blue→red = more frequent) / R: record / toggle again to exit

renderOnNoDev.message: Render viz ON — no dev build detected, timing unavailable (flash only)

treeOn.message: Component tree ON — hover a row to highlight, hover the page to locate it. Esc to close

treeOnSafe.message: Component tree ON — no dev build detected, names are estimated

recordStart.message: Recording — interact to trigger re-renders, press R to stop and see the ranking

statsColsSupported.message: Hover a row for why it re-rendered (state / props / parent)

statsColsUnsupported.message: Production build: render counts and causes are exact, timings need a dev build

statsWastedHint.message: wasted = re-rendered by a parent with identical props → React.memo candidate

statsCopied.message: Report copied — paste it into your AI assistant to start the analysis

statsCopyFail.message: Copy failed — clipboard is unavailable on this page

themeTokensLoaded.message: MUI theme detected — {colors} colors / {sizes} sizes added as tokens
themeTokensLoaded.description: Toast when the MUI theme is auto-extracted (FR-14). {colors}/{sizes} are counts.

treeUnavailableProd.message: Component tree needs a development build — this page is a production build, where React strips component names. Design measurement and token matching still work.

hintEditorUsage.message: While inspecting, ⌘/Ctrl+Click an element to open its source, or use the right-click menu. Development builds only — production builds carry no source location, so the extension tells you why instead. The editor you pick must be installed; if nothing opens, the extension offers the path to copy.

hintPathMappings.message: One per line, from=to. Needed when the path the browser reports is not the path on your disk (Docker, remote dev, monorepo). The first matching prefix is replaced.

modeNotEnabledHere.message: Not enabled on this site yet — use "Enable on current site…" above first. (localhost works without this.)

modeNotInspectable.message: This page can't be inspected (not an http/https page).
